title_en: Korean Register Recruitment for Nuclear Power Positions
summary: The Korean Register (KR) is recruiting staff to work on nuclear-powered vessel matters. Interested applicants must apply through the KR recruitment website (https://krs.recruit-zone.co.kr/) by 8 October. The process after the application stage will be conducted as blind recruitment.
applies_to: Anyone interested in employment with the Korean Register in work related to nuclear-powered vessels. The notice does not state any eligibility limits, and application is voluntary.
conditions: All stages after the application stage are conducted as blind recruitment.
steps: Apply on the KR recruitment website (https://krs.recruit-zone.co.kr/) by 8 October.
translation:
Title: Korean Register Recruitment in the Nuclear Power Field

The Korean Register (한국선급, KR) intends to recruit staff to carry out work related to nuclear-powered vessels.

KR recruitment website (https://krs.recruit-zone.co.kr/)

Applications close on 8 October, and the subsequent process will be conducted as blind recruitment.
